review:
The Dog House – Muttley Crew sends the series out to sea, swapping the kennel for a pirate ship and paylines for clusters. On a 5x5 grid, five or more matching symbols touching each other form a win, with the pirate dogs and a golden bone as the top-paying symbols.

Treasure chest wilds can appear at any time and carry multipliers of up to 10x that apply to any cluster they join. Paw-print scatters award up to 20 free spins, and during the bonus those multiplier wilds become sticky, keeping their value until the round ends. Additional scatters can add up to 30 extra spins. The game advertises a top win of 7,500x. It keeps the series' sticky-wild idea but the cluster format makes it feel noticeably different from the classic line games, so it is worth trying in demo even if you already know the originals.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
